title: Ditransitives beyond give
description: The double-object frame — first noun phrase に, second を — for the verbs that take it: show, buy, tell, lend, send, teach, pass, bring, pay, hand; and let X V with an object.

cases.expect: 彼女は私に彼女の部屋を見せた。

cases.sentence: my uncle bought me this book .
cases.expect: 私のおじは私にこの本を買った。

cases.sentence: let me buy you a drink .
cases.expect: あなたに飲み物を買わせてください。
